description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rydia (Earth)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Gaia's Wrath (0~2), removed after using Gaia's Wrath two times

description.name: Gaia's Wrath Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Gaia's Wrath level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rydia (Earth)]

description.name: Gaia's Wrath Level
description.text: Keeps track of Gaia's Wrath level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rydia (Earth)]
